title: Vitta Path (UP Finance Department guide, 2012): General Provident Fund
titleHi: वित्त पथ: सामान्य भविष्य निर्वाह निधि
edition: Vitta Path (2012), chapter by Vivek Kr. Singh
sourceNote: Official (Finance Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh, budget.up.nic.in/vittapath). Vitta Path (वित्त पथ) is the Finance Department's 2012 practical guide to UP financial and service rules, one chapter per subject written by finance officers. It explains the rules; rates, limits and procedures may have changed since 2012, and the rule itself and later government orders prevail. The PDFs use the Kruti Dev font; their text is converted to Unicode Hindi when pages are built.
